Expanded tests/test_agentbus_control.py from 6 to 24 tests covering: reflect wire-constants, reflect_request/result payloads, _normalize_narrative edge cases (None/empty/whitespace/truncation/exact-cap), inventory-only shape (no reflection key), narrative-included shape, empty/whitespace narrative normalization, overlong-narrative truncation, and whitespace-stripping. All 24 tests pass.
